title: Poll NSX Policy segment realization with VCF PowerCLI
prompt: Complete the PowerShell module under src/Vcf.Nsx.Policy.Async. Implement Set-VcfNsxInfraSegment so it submits an infra segment with the spec-derived PatchInfraSegment operation and then polls ReadIntentStatus until realization reaches a terminal state. SUCCESS returns a summary object, ERROR throws, and all nonterminal ConfigState values remain bounded by TimeoutSeconds. The production transport must be built on the VMware.Sdk.Nsx.Policy commands shipped in the preinstalled VCF PowerCLI 9.1 distribution; declare that external module dependency and do not vendor VMware modules or generated bindings. Build both PowerCLI splats and transport request bodies by presence: an optional parameter that was not supplied must not be emitted as null, an empty string, or an empty array. Preserve the public parameters and injectable transport seam documented in README.md so the loopback acceptance environment can exercise the workflow without a VMware endpoint. The reduced contract in docs/contract.json is authoritative for method, path, query, body field names, response shape, operationIds, and ConfigState values. Do not modify docs/, fixtures/, or tests/. Run python3 tests/verify.py from the repository root.
